title: Winter Conference headliners: Sustaining momentum
summary: Tuesday’s plenary session at the 2026 ANS Winter Conference & Expo may have involved three different formats—introductory speeches, a panel discussion, and a fireside chat—but ultimately had one overarching theme: sustaining momentum. With technology, policy, and financing seemingly aligning within the nuclear energy industry, Tuesday’s speakers urged attendees to seize the moment and build on it, whether it was through small moments at the conference or larger efforts at their respective workplaces.

title: Sweden’s Skanska Completes Critical Demonstrator Project For Rolls-Royce SMR
summary: Swedish construction company Skanska has successfully completed an aseismic bearing pedestal demonstrator for Rolls-Royce SMR, marking an important milestone in the development of the British company’s factory-built small modular reactor (SMR) nuclear power plant. The demonstrator, constructed and trialled at Skanska’s Bentley Works facility in Doncaster, northern England, has proven the approach to producing the first-of-its-kind precast bearing pedestal offsite, Skanska said.

title: Crews complete demolition of ORNL’s Isotope Row
summary: The Department of Energy’s Office of Environmental Management announced on November 10 that crews have demolished the 10 buildings that once made up Oak Ridge National Laboratory’s Isotope Row, completing the work approximately two months after demolition commenced.

title: IAEA Team Welcomes Ageing Management Improvements At Japan’s Mihama-3
summary: An International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) team has welcomed improvements in ageing management at the Mihama-3 nuclear plant in Japan, but said the operator should ensure the adequate coordination and oversight of key activities. The team, which reviewed the long-term operational safety of Mihama-3, said Kansai Electric Power Company (Kepco) should also ensure the adequate analysis and use of external operating experience from external organisations in the area of long-term operation and improve the analysis and management of data for ageing management.

title: ANS names 2026 Presidential Citation, CEO Service Leadership Award recipients
summary: ANS President Mark Peters recognized several Presidential Citation recipients on November 16 at the opening plenary of the 2026 ANS Winter Conference & Expo in Phoenix, Ariz. Presidential Citations are conferred twice each year, at the Annual and Winter Conferences of the American Nuclear Society, to honor individuals who have demonstrated outstanding effort for the benefit of ANS or the nuclear community at large.

title: France’s State Auditor Warns On Funding Problems For Six Planned EPR2 Nuclear Power Plants
summary: French state utility and nuclear plant operator EDF could face difficulties funding the construction of six new generation nuclear reactors, a state auditor’s report said ​on 16 November. In a report on public support for energy (French only), the Cour des Comptes, France’s public audit body, said the utility faces heavy financial exposure across its long-term nuclear projects and could ​require substantial state backing if energy market revenues fail to ​cover building, maintenance and operating costs. It said EDF’s planned construction of ⁠six EPR2 reactors is budgeted at €72.8bn ($80.24bn) in 2020 values, ​which the court calculated at €84bn in 2025 values, with first ​commercial operation scheduled from 2038.
